# Optional video posters

The four customer cards now use the supplied self-hosted MP4s and show real
video frames. Poster files are optional.

To add an explicit poster, save a clear 9:16 frame here as aarav.jpg,
rohan.jpg, aditya.jpg or kunal.jpg and set that entry's poster path in
src/data/videoReviews.js. Use 720x1280 optimized JPEG/WebP. No AI-generated
customer imagery or automatic Instagram thumbnail fetching is used.
